author: mark202611
quote:
Please refund my money. I saved up 100 dollars despite my third world income and this was much worse than GTA 5 and even Watch Dogs 1 and 2.

The gameplay is not fun because it does not feel cool to do chores and drive old and cheap cars. 

The characters are deeply unlikable, especially Lucia. And the worst part is that the game is not designed such that you can abandon her at all. I would have appreciated an option where we ditch Lucia early on in the game and actually play grand theft auto and not have this corny relationship.

 I hate the 30fps limit. I hate how stretched out this story is.

Please refund.
